tagline.en: Vivace card, new identity, safer and smoother everywhere.
tagline.id: Kartu Vivace, identitas baru, lebih aman dan mulus di mana-mana.

items.en: Vivace: a new loyalty card above Monarch, with its own tag, badge and effects.
items.id: Vivace: kartu loyalty baru di atas Monarch, lengkap dengan tag, badge, dan efek.

items.en: Platinum, Infinite and Black cards redesigned. Early loyalty levels come faster.
items.id: Kartu Platinum, Infinite, dan Black didesain ulang. Level loyalty awal lebih cepat.

items.en: Mini profile on click, role tags left of names, prefix/suffix in Settings with formatting codes.
items.id: Mini profil saat diklik, tag role di kiri nama, prefix/suffix di Settings dengan kode format.

items.en: Performance presets: Ultra, High, Medium, Potato.
items.id: Preset performa: Ultra, Tinggi, Sedang, Potato.

items.en: Max bet shown now matches what the server accepts. Banners readable in light mode.
items.id: Max bet yang tampil sekarang sama dengan yang diterima server. Banner terbaca di mode terang.

items.en: Crash can reach ×10,000, anti-bot check on login and sign-up.
items.id: Crash bisa sampai ×10.000, cek anti-bot saat login dan daftar.
